games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: In 'The Cracked Charter', why was the stamp on the town charter surprising?
choices: It had been printed in gold ink by the curator.
It belonged to the regional capital, not the town.
It showed the date the museum first opened its doors.
It had been drawn by one of the visiting architects.
rounds.answer: It belonged to the regional capital, not the town.
rounds.explanation: Teacher Yasmin recognises the symbol as legislative and explains that it came from the regional capital.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence contains a simile?
choices: The wind rattled every door in the neighbourhood.
The wind is an angry visitor.
The old acacia tree trembled and bent.
Sheets of laundry flew like startled birds.
rounds.answer: Sheets of laundry flew like startled birds.
rounds.explanation: Only this option uses like. The second option is a metaphor, and the other two describe events literally.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'artifacts' mean?
choices: Rules that explain how a country or club works.
People who design buildings and bridges.
Objects made by people a long time ago.
A large area where visitors wait.
rounds.answer: Objects made by people a long time ago.
rounds.explanation: The other options define constitution, architects and lobby, which the story also uses but with different meanings.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: In 'The River', the poet writes that the river is a silver traveller. Is that a simile or a metaphor, and how can you tell?
choices: It is a metaphor, because the poet says the river is a traveller instead of comparing it with like or as.
It is figurative, because the dew drops are not really rings; their round shine is compared with jewellery.
She means a disagreement broke the council's unity, just as a crack breaks a page in two.
rounds.answer: It is a metaphor, because the poet says the river is a traveller instead of comparing it with like or as.
rounds.explanation: Review the unit text evidence: It is a metaphor, because the poet says the river is a traveller instead of comparing it with like or as.

rounds.prompt: What does Mina do when the wind reaches the house, and what question does she ask her older sister?
choices: It is figurative, because the dew drops are not really rings; their round shine is compared with jewellery.
He feared tension would spread like an infection, but Nora said fear of expansion cannot justify silencing people.
Mina hides under the table with her eyes wide open and asks whether the wind is angry.
rounds.answer: Mina hides under the table with her eyes wide open and asks whether the wind is angry.
rounds.explanation: Review the unit text evidence: Mina hides under the table with her eyes wide open and asks whether the wind is angry.

rounds.prompt: What does the curator mean when she says the town council had a fracture in trust?

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Complete the sentence correctly: 'A haiku is ______ than a ballad.'
choices: more short
shortest
the most short
shorter
rounds.answer: shorter
rounds.explanation: Short has one syllable, so it takes -er, and than shows that exactly two things are being compared.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses a superlative correctly?
choices: She wrote the best haiku in the class.
She wrote the goodest haiku in the class.
She wrote the more good haiku in the class.
She wrote best haiku in the class.
rounds.answer: She wrote the best haiku in the class.
rounds.explanation: Good is irregular, so its superlative is best, and a superlative needs the in front of it.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'legislative' mean?
choices: Working together with others.
A break or crack in something hard.
Related to making laws or rules.
The way you hold your body.
rounds.answer: Related to making laws or rules.
rounds.explanation: The other three options define collaborative, fracture and posture, which are all different unit words.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence contains a metaphor?
choices: The river is a silver traveller.
The river runs quickly past our town.
The river is as cold as ice.
The river flooded the low fields in April.
rounds.answer: The river is a silver traveller.
rounds.explanation: A metaphor states that one thing is another. The third option uses as, so it is a simile, and the others are literal.

rounds.prompt: How many syllables must the second line of a haiku have?
choices: Three
Five
Seven
Nine
rounds.answer: Seven
rounds.explanation: A haiku follows a five, seven, five pattern, so the middle line is the longest of the three.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a break or crack in something hard?
choices: posture
fracture
vulture
miniature
rounds.answer: fracture
rounds.explanation: Posture is how you hold your body, a vulture is a bird, and a miniature is a very small copy of something.
